choices.text: Pocket the drive. Log it later. Maybe.
Log it properly. Chain of custody matters.

scenes.text:
Your encrypted drive holds the crash-field footage. You've watched it eleven times.

On the twelfth viewing you notice the timestamp.

The footage is dated [b]tomorrow[/b].

Somebody — or something — recorded the crash field a full day before the fragments fell. The file's chain of custody is clean. The math is not.
scenes.title: CHAIN OF CUSTODY

choices.text: Take the drive down to the crash field.

scenes.text:
[b]PERFECT.[/b] The decryption holds. Frame by frame, tomorrow's crash field resolves — lanterns, fragments, the whole camp.

In the last frame, at the edge of the largest fragment's glow, there is a figure in a camp jacket.

The jacket has your name on it, {name}.
scenes.title: THE TWELFTH VIEWING
